points.description: Defines classification as a task that maps/assigns data to discrete labels or categories (e.g. predicts a class/category label). Accept equivalent wording.
Defines regression as a task that maps data to a continuous function or real values (e.g. predicts a continuous numeric value). Accept equivalent wording.

States the error difference: classification error is the number of misclassifications, while regression error is the summed distance between the true and predicted values (or equivalent residual/distance error).

rubric.notes: Full marks require a correct definition of classification as mapping to discrete labels/categories, regression as mapping to continuous/real values, and the error distinction between misclassification count and summed distance. Part marks are earned for each correct component present. Vague statements that do not identify the output type or error measure earn no marks.
